title: Fix three bugs in a Python Trie class
description: Fix bugs in Trie: insert never marks end_of_word, search returns True for any traversed node (including prefixes), starts_with returns True even when prefix is absent.

files.tests/test_trie.py:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from src.trie import Trie


def test_search_exact():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert('cat')
    assert t.search('cat') is True


def test_search_prefix_not_word():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert('cat')
    assert t.search('ca') is False


def test_starts_with_present():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert('cat')
    assert t.starts_with('ca') is True


def test_starts_with_absent():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert('cat')
    assert t.starts_with('do') is False

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/trie.py:
1. insert: add `node.end_of_word = True` after the loop so inserted words are marked complete
2. search: return `node.end_of_word` instead of `node is not None` so prefixes don't match as words
3. starts_with: return `False` (not `True`) when a prefix character is missing from children
All 4 tests must pass.
